title: Content (Notion)
description: Alle Einträge der Content-Datenbank mit Status, Format, Kanal und Veröffentlichungsdatum.

data.query: SELECT "Content-ID" AS id, "Name" AS name, "Status" AS status, "Priorität" AS prio, "Format" AS format, "Kanal" AS kanal, "Ziel" AS ziel, "Entität" AS entitaet, "date:Veröffentlichung:start" AS datum, "Aufrufe" AS aufrufe, "Nächster Schritt" AS naechster_schritt, url FROM "collection://3526a97b-fc76-474e-be72-88a52cc8de41" ORDER BY "date:Veröffentlichung:start" DESC, "Content-ID" DESC
